def lay(r, lo, u, k):
    """Where k pieces of topping go in one row of a slice u columns wide: every piece is
    two cells and there are at least two cheese cells between pieces."""
    if not k:
        return []
    if 4 * k - 2 > u:
        return None
    b = sorted(r.sample(range(u - 3 * k + 2), k))
    return [lo + b[i] + 3 * i for i in range(k)]


def look(S, x, w):
    """(n, the near-misses this cut tray shows).  n = how many slices hold two or more
    pieces of x.  Each flag is a rival reading of the picture that the picture itself
    refutes, so that the one demo a player pays for can settle it."""
    hot = [sum(d.get(x, (0, 0, 0))) > 1 for d in S]
    f = 0
    for i, d in enumerate(S):
        v = d.get(x, (0, 0, 0))
        t = sum(v)
        other = max([sum(u) for L, u in d.items() if L != x] or [0])
        if t == 1:
            f |= 1                                    # one of it is not enough
            if not other:
                f |= 2                                # and nothing else on that slice
        if t < 2 < other:
            f |= 4                                    # two of ANOTHER topping: not sprinkled
        if hot[i]:
            if t == 2:
                f |= 8                                # a sprinkled slice of exactly two
            else:
                f |= 16                               # and one of three: not "exactly two"
            if max(v) == t:
                f |= 32                               # its pieces all on one row
            elif max(v) < 2:
                f |= 64                               # and one with them on separate rows
        if not t:
            f |= 128                                  # a slice with none of it at all
    if not hot[max(range(len(w)), key=lambda i: w[i])]:
        f |= 256                                      # the widest slice is not sprinkled
    return sum(hot), f


def tray(r, nil):
    """One tray bake, built from the picture it has to show.  The slices are cut first
    and given their parts to play (the sprinkled ones, the one carrying a single piece
    of the named topping, the one carrying two of another topping, the fillers), and the
    toppings are then laid into them."""
    ns = r.randint(5, 7)
    T = r.randint(34, 46)
    w = [4] * ns
    for _ in range(T - 4 * ns):                       # slice widths: hand-cut, never even
        c = [i for i in range(ns) if w[i] < 12]
        if not c:
            return None
        w[r.choice(c)] += 1
    if min(w) > 6 or max(w) - min(w) < 4:
        return None
    u = list(w)
    u[0] -= 2                                         # the crust eats two columns at
    u[-1] -= 2                                        # each end of the tray
    x, y, z = r.sample("mpotacsb", 3)
    plan = [[[] for _ in range(3)] for _ in range(ns)]      # slice -> row -> toppings
    order = sorted(range(ns), key=lambda i: (u[i], r.random()))
    wide = order[-1]                                  # the widest slice is never sprinkled
    mid = [i for i in order if i != wide and 0 < i < ns - 1]
    free = [i for i in order if i != wide and i not in mid]
    r.shuffle(mid)
    r.shuffle(free)
    if nil:
        roles = [("lone", 1), ("two", 1)]             # nothing is sprinkled, so no slice
        for _ in range(r.randint(3, 4)):              # may hold two of the named topping
            roles.append(("one", 1))
    else:
        roles = [("pair", 2), ("trio", 1)]            # the sprinkled slices are never the
        if r.random() < .55:                          # end ones, which carry crust
            roles.append(("split", 2))                # a third one: the caption says 3
        roles += [("lone", 1), ("two", 1)]
    slots = []
    for role, need in roles:
        got = None
        for pool in ((mid,) if role in ("pair", "trio", "split") else (free, mid)):
            for j, i in enumerate(pool):
                if (u[i] + 2) // 4 >= need:
                    got = pool.pop(j)
                    break
            if got is not None:
                break
        if got is None:
            return None
        slots.append((role, got))
    free += mid
    rows = [0, 1, 2]
    lone = None
    for role, i in slots:
        r.shuffle(rows)
        if role == "pair":                            # two of it side by side on one row
            plan[i][rows[0]] += [x, x]
        elif role == "trio":                          # three of it, one on each row
            for q in rows:
                plan[i][q].append(x)
        elif role == "split":                         # two of it, on different rows
            plan[i][rows[0]].append(x)
            plan[i][rows[1]].append(x)
        elif role == "lone":                          # one piece of it and nothing else
            plan[i][rows[0]].append(x)
            lone = i
        elif role == "one":                           # one piece of it among the rest
            plan[i][rows[0]].append(x)
        elif (u[i] + 2) // 4 > 1 and r.random() < .6:  # two of ANOTHER topping, side by
            plan[i][rows[0]] += [y, y]                 # side, and not sprinkled for it
        else:
            plan[i][rows[0]].append(y)
            plan[i][rows[1]].append(y)
    for i in free + [wide]:                           # a stray piece of it here and there
        if r.random() < .45:
            plan[i][r.choice(rows)].append(x)
    for _ in range(r.randint(7, 11)):                 # and the other toppings on top, so
        q = min(rows, key=lambda q: (sum(len(plan[i][q]) for i in range(ns)), r.random()))
        c = [i for i in range(ns)                     # that a sprinkled slice is not the
             if i != lone and 4 * len(plan[i][q]) + 2 <= u[i]]       # fullest one either
        if c:
            plan[r.choice(c)][q].append(r.choice((y, z, z)))
    pos = 0
    cells = [[":"] * T for _ in range(3)]
    for q in range(3):                                # a baked crust two columns thick
        cells[q][0] = cells[q][1] = cells[q][-1] = cells[q][-2] = "#"
    S = [{} for _ in range(ns)]
    cut = []
    for i in range(ns):
        lo = pos + (2 if not i else 0)
        for q in range(3):
            bag = plan[i][q]
            r.shuffle(bag)
            p = lay(r, lo, u[i], len(bag))
            if p is None:
                return None
            for c, L in zip(p, bag):
                cells[q][c] = cells[q][c + 1] = L
                v = S[i].get(L)
                if not v:
                    v = S[i][L] = [0, 0, 0]
                v[q] += 1
        pos += w[i]
        if i < ns - 1:
            cut.append(pos)
    n, f = look(S, x, w)
    if (n == 0) != nil or (not nil and not 2 <= n <= 3) or f & 5 != 5:
        return None
    if not nil and f & 0x1f8 != 0x1f8:      # every cut tray shows the whole sentence
        return None
    crust = "#" * T
    pic = [crust] + ["".join(cs) for cs in cells] + [crust]
    return "%s\n%s %d sprinkle" % (
        "\n".join("".join("|" + ch if i in cut else ch for i, ch in enumerate(l))
                  for l in pic), x, n)


def generate(seed):
    r = random.Random(seed)
    nil = r.random() < 0.12          # ~1 tray in 8 gets no sprinkle at all: the answer
    for _ in range(60):              # is then the clue handed back unchanged
        c = tray(r, nil)
        if c:
            return c
    return ""

def solve(clue):
  """The tray with every sprinkled slice's cheese turned to stars.  A slice is sprinkled
  when it holds two or more pieces of the caption's topping - a piece is two cells, so
  four cells or more.  The caption line itself is not part of the answer."""
  a = clue.split("\n")
  x = a[-1][0]
  G = [l.split("|") for l in a if ":" in l]
  hot = [sum(g[i].count(x) for g in G) > 3 for i in range(len(G[0]))]
  return "\n".join("|".join(p[i].replace(":", "*") if hot[i] else p[i]
                            for i in range(len(p)))
                   for p in [l.split("|") for l in a[:-1]])
